meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 iMessage 适配器复制进 src/channels/ 并注册、安装 chat-adapter-imessage 依赖、构建并运行注册测试,再按 local 或 remote 模式写好 .env 并重启服务,使 NanoClaw 能收发 iMessage。
howto.when: 当你提到「add imessage」「connect imessage」等关键词,或要求给 NanoClaw 接入 iMessage 渠道时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 加上 iMessage 渠道
iMessage 用 local 模式,就这台 Mac
say.note: 会提示给 Node 授予完全磁盘访问权限

say.text: iMessage 用 remote 模式,走 Photon
say.note: 会要你的 Photon 服务器 URL 和 API key

howto.what_en: Claude copies the iMessage adapter into src/channels/, registers it, installs chat-adapter-imessage, builds and runs the registration test, then writes .env for local or remote mode and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "add imessage" or "connect imessage", or when you ask to add an iMessage channel to NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add the iMessage channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Runs the Apply steps, then asks local or remote

say_en.text: Use local iMessage mode on this Mac
say_en.note: Prompts for Full Disk Access for Node

say_en.text: Use remote iMessage mode via Photon
say_en.note: Asks for your Photon server URL and API key
